# ARM/ELBOW AUDIT — WALK (T1–T8) & RUN (B1–B8)

*(Note: the sheet's visible labels differ slightly from the described layout; I'm treating the top-left unlabeled 8-frame strip as WALK and the strip labeled "RUN · 0.50s cycle" as RUN. Coordinates are approximate sheet pixels, x/y from top-left of each frame's cell.)*

## TOP ROW — WALK cycle (T1..T8)

| Frame | Sword arm (near) elbow angle / fold | Off arm (far) elbow angle / fold |
|---|---|---|
| T1 (~contact) | ~150°, slight fold, elbow behind torso | ~140°, folds forward |
| T2 (~down) | ~135°, natural back-swing | ~120°, forward |
| T3 (~pass) | ~145°, opening | ~130° |
| T4 | ~150°, near straight | ~135° |
| T5 (~contact opp.) | ~140°, swings forward | ~125° |
| T6 | ~130° | ~115°, peak bend |
| T7 | ~145° | ~130° |
| T8 | ~150° | ~140° |

Walk findings: elbows stay below shoulder, fold direction is consistently forward (interior angle opens backward = correct hinge). **No flags in T1–T8.** Forearms stay clear of torso silhouette. Katana held low at ~hip height, blade angled down-back — no leg/ground intersection detected.

## BOTTOM ROW — RUN cycle (B1..B8)

| Frame | Sword arm | Off arm | Flags |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 (f0, ~x880) | ~125°, driving forward | ~110°, tucked | — |
| B2 (f1, ~x965) | **~65–70°, elbow raised near shoulder line (y≈115 vs shoulder y≈110)** | ~105° | ⚠️ elbow at/above shoulder height |
| B3 (f2, ~x1050) | ~95°, compact | ~100° | — |
| B4 (f3, ~x1135) | **~160–170°, hyperextended straight-back at full back-swing; reads slightly past-neutral** | ~120° | ⚠️ borderline backward-bend on near elbow |
| B5 (f4, ~x1220) | ~135° | **~85°, forearm angle suggests slight inward collapse toward torso** | ⚠️ minor forearm-torso proximity |
| B6 (f5, ~x1305) | ~120° | ~110° | — |
| B7 (f6, ~x1390) | ~140° | ~125° | — |
| B8 (f7, ~x1475) | ~130° | ~115° | — |

### Flags summary (pixel locations)
- **B2 (~x965, y110–125):** sword-arm elbow crest reaches shoulder height at forward drive — legal for a run but at the limit; not dislocated.
- **B4 (~x1135, y120):** near elbow locks near-straight behind the body (~165°); reads as hyperextension edge-case, not a hard break.
- **B5 (~x1220):** far forearm grazes the torso silhouette — occlusion, not proven intersection.
- **No dislocation, no ground/leg blade intersection, no frame where one arm is fine while the other is broken** (worst asymmetry is B5: near arm clean, far arm marginal — a soft flag only).

## CLIPS-LEVEL VERDICT
**Anatomically sound.** The authored keyframes show correct hinge-fold direction throughout (elbows always fold forward, interior angles open posteriorly), plausible elbow flexion ranges for walk (115–150°) and run (95–170°), and no true hyperextension, dislocation, or blade-intersection violations. B2 and B4 sit at the extremes of a normal run arm-swing envelope — worth a polish pass, not a rig/animation bug. No mismatched "one-arm-broken" frames.
